create_optimizer: create optimizer with per-network learning rates for lipreading, facial, unet, and vocal attribute networks
display_val: display validation loss across mix-and-separate, co-separation, and crossmodal losses with tensorboard logging
get_mixandseparate_loss: compute mix-and-separate loss from predicted and ground truth masks for audio sources A and B
get_coseparation_loss: compute co-separation loss using triplet loss on audio embeddings from predicted or ground truth sources
get_crossmodal_loss: compute crossmodal loss aligning audio embeddings with facial identity features via triplet loss
